title: Unmarked black helicopters arrive at Ellsworth
place_text: Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota

tellings.quote: it over the next few weeks suddenly we had an influx of black shoy helicopters completely unmarked

plain: In the 1960s, at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, a sudden wave of completely unmarked black helicopters is said to have arrived over a few weeks. Michels reads this out from a witness he does not name, in an episode with the researcher Robert Hastings about UFOs and nuclear bases. If true, someone with no visible markings was moving in force onto a military base.
